style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>Origin &amp; Coverage (connectivity.md)</b><br/>• 200 coffee farms in Cauca, Huila, Tolima (2 nodes/farm, ASM-070)<br/>• Cellular LPWA radio (LTE-M/NB-IoT, satellite dual-mode)<br/>• No gateway, mast, repeater or wired link installed (A10 sec 4.1)<br/><br/><b>Telemetry Payload &amp; Cadence</b><br/>• Soil moisture (10cm, 30cm), soil temp, air temp/humidity, NPK<br/>• Node publishes every reading as taken; no persistent session<br/><br/><b>Transport &amp; Buffer (connectivity.md)</b><br/>• MQTT over TLS 1.2 or later with mutual X.509 cert auth<br/>• QoS 1, port 8883 (port 443 with ALPN fallback)<br/>• Up to 24h encrypted non-volatile store-and-forward buffer" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="265" width="370" x="85" y="225" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_t2" parent="1" 'aroma/+/telemetry'</i><br/>• Action 1: PutItem directly into DynamoDB telemetry table<br/>• Action 2: SQS message action to threshold evaluation queue<br/><br/><b>Rule Error Action (ASM-161, <i>telemetry</i> keyed by node_id and reading_timestamp<br/>• Encrypted with KMS CMK (<i>telemetry</i> key class, ASM-097)<br/>• 5-year retention by TTL; strongly consistent reads (ASM-161)<br/><br/><b>Thresholds Table (farm-monitoring.md sec 4)</b><br/>• Table: <i>thresholds</i> in workload account, KMS CMK encrypted<br/>• Federation data: Partition key <i>rule_key</i>, sort key <i>effective_from</i><br/>• Versioned &amp; audited: reason, Federation reference, operator ID<br/>• Farm scope override evaluated first, fallback to pilot scope" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry div.div:
Origin & Coverage (connectivity.md)
• 200 coffee farms in Cauca, Huila, Tolima (2 nodes/farm, ASM-070)
• Cellular LPWA radio (LTE-M/NB-IoT, satellite dual-mode)
• No gateway, mast, repeater or wired link installed (A10 sec 4.1)
Telemetry Payload & Cadence
• Soil moisture (10cm, 30cm), soil temp, air temp/humidity, NPK
• Node publishes every reading as taken; no persistent session
Transport & Buffer (connectivity.md)
• MQTT over TLS 1.2 or later with mutual X.509 cert auth
• QoS 1, port 8883 (port 443 with ALPN fallback)
• Up to 24h encrypted non-volatile store-and-forward buffer

div.div:
Ingress & Authentication
• Regional endpoint in us-east-1, mutual TLS with X.509
• Node policy restricts publish to aroma/{farm_id}/telemetry
IoT Topic Rule Actions (ADR-003, ASM-161)
• SQL rule: SELECT * FROM 'aroma/+/telemetry'
• Action 1: PutItem directly into DynamoDB telemetry table
• Action 2: SQS message action to threshold evaluation queue
Rule Error Action (ASM-161, ASM-162)
• Error action routes failed payloads to IoT Rule SQS DLQ
• Retries up to 5 attempts before DLQ routing

div.div:
Telemetry Table (ADR-003, farm-monitoring.md)
• Table: telemetry keyed by node_id and reading_timestamp
• Encrypted with KMS CMK (telemetry key class, ASM-097)
• 5-year retention by TTL; strongly consistent reads (ASM-161)
Thresholds Table (farm-monitoring.md sec 4)
• Table: thresholds in workload account, KMS CMK encrypted
• Federation data: Partition key rule_key, sort key effective_from
• Versioned & audited: reason, Federation reference, operator ID
• Farm scope override evaluated first, fallback to pilot scope

div.div:
SQS Queue Trigger (ASM-161, ASM-162)
• Triggered by threshold SQS queue, batch size 10 (ASM-162)
• Function: 60s timeout, 256MB, reserved concurrency 10
Evaluation Logic (farm-monitoring.md sec 5)
• Strongly consistent read of reading from DynamoDB telemetry
• Evaluates reading against active Federation thresholds
• Thresholds are Federation data, never hardcoded in rule SQL
Alert Generation & Deployment [D11]
• If out of range: persists crop_alert_raised and emits to SNS
• Deployed via CodeDeploy canary (10% 5 min, D11)

div.div:
Farmer Notification (ASM-075, farm-monitoring.md)
• SNS alert topic (alerts key class, ASM-097)
• Push notification & SMS sent to farmer phone
• Design target: Alert delivery under 5 minutes (ASM-075)
Case Management & Observation
• Opens or updates agronomic case in DynamoDB (section 5.1)
• Agronomist portal reads cases and alerts by department
• Pilot-wide observation metrics emitted to CloudWatch

div.div:
Flight Missions (ADR-002, drone-service.md)
• Combined mode: Area delimitation/estimation & precision confirmation/verification
• Certified operator pilot; photos, track, maps, polygons, flight record
On-Device Person Screen (ASM-164)
• Ground station runs on-device person detector prior to upload
• Manifest records person_screen: clear or person_present
• Zero cloud person detectors used; protects privacy cryptographically
Authentication & Buffer (drone-service.md sec 7)
• Pilot authenticates via Cognito staff pool with MFA
• Local buffer retained until signed receipt received from platform

div.div:
Object Storage Target (drone-service.md sec 7)
• Workload S3 bucket with mission-prefixed keys
• Direct upload via time-limited Pre-signed URL from upload grant
• S3 verifies SHA-256 header checksum on upload (HTTP 400 on error)
Encryption & 5-Year Lifecycle (ASM-097, drone-service.md line 197)
• Server-Side Encryption with KMS CMK (drone key class)
• 5-year retention enforced by S3 lifecycle rules
Person Screening & Quarantine Prefix (ASM-165)
• Objects with person_present moved to restricted/person/
• Encrypted under 8th KMS key class restricted (no function access)

div.div:
Manifest Validation & Receipt (drone-service.md sec 7)
• Reception Lambda validates manifest, checksums, and flight record
• Writes mission item to DynamoDB missions table (status: record_persisted)
• Returns receipt to ground station to release local mission buffer
Event Routing to Inference (ASM-161)
• DynamoDB Stream captures changes into record_persisted
• EventBridge Pipe filters for record_persisted to drone event bus
• EventBridge rules dispatch to dedicated SQS queue per mission type
• Lambda event source mapping reads with batch size 1 (ASM-161)

div.div:
Managed Foundation Model (ASM-160, architecture.md Part E)
• Amazon Bedrock invoked on-demand in us-east-1
• Vision-capable model, initially Amazon Nova Pro (foundation-model ID)
• Zero-shot prompts & JSON schemas kept as versioned configuration
• Zero training, fine-tuning, or persistent compute (ASM-160)
Confidence & Result Persistence (ASM-160, ASM-163)
• Returns uncalibrated confidence score; threshold >= 0.70 (ASM-163)
• Output stored in DynamoDB with timestamp, confidence, object key
• Never authorizes fumigation or closure directly (ADR-002)

div.div:
Human-in-the-Loop Authorization (ADR-002)
• Federation agronomist reviews AI confidence score and source photos
• Agronomist authorizes fumigation prescription as human with MFA
Order & Case Progression
• Updates case to focus_confirmed and emits fumigation order
• Verification flight closes case and mission order upon agronomist sign-off
Traceability & Origin Audit
• Audit record tied to coffee parcel origin for port delivery
